notes.title: Starhome – Development Update: Travelling Phase
notes.notes:
[p][b]Greetings, Star Travelers![/b][/p][p]It’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been busy working on the core features of [i]STARHOME[/i]. Our focus right now is on building the [b]vertical slice[/b] - a milestone that will showcase all the key systems working together. Every day we’re getting closer, and today we’d like to share a sneak peek at one of the gameplay phases that has evolved the most in recent months.[/p][p]

[b]Travelling Phase – Faster Than Light Journeys[/b][/p][p]The galaxy is vast, and choosing the perfect landing spot for your fleet is no easy task. Planning your destination is just the beginning - the journey itself is a challenge you’ll need to master.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="C318-ZXUayk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]While travelling between star systems, you’ll be responsible for keeping your crew and passengers alive and your ships operational. This means:[/p][list][*][p][b]Supplying essential resources[/b] - from food to metals - to keep everyone fed and your fleet maintained.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Constructing key structures[/b] aboard your ships to ensure safety, efficiency, and readiness for whatever awaits at your destination.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Managing your growing fleet and population[/b] so that you arrive stronger, not weaker, than when you departed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Run out of supplies or neglect maintenance, and you might find yourself in… let’s call it an [i]uncomfortable[/i] situation.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]What’s Next[/b][/h3][p]We’re approaching the point where we can begin [b]internal playtests[/b]. Once we’ve gathered feedback and made improvements, our next step will be [b]closed community playtests[/b] - where you’ll have the chance to help shape [i]STARHOME[/i] into something truly special.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience, excitement, and support. We can’t wait to share more with you as the journey continues![/p]

notes.title: STARHOME - Official Development Update: A New Dawn for an Old Dream
notes.notes:
After some time of silence, we are thrilled to announce that STARHOME is back in development with a brand-new title, team and vision! Today, we're excited to share with you the first new trailer, marking the beginning of an exciting journey for this ambitious project. 

[previewyoutube=f1hXdkJHSas;full][/previewyoutube]
In STARHOME, you'll take command of a fleet of starships that are all that's left of your civilization. This isn't just a game about survival—it's about thriving in the harsh realities of deep space. You'll be managing the limited space of each spacecraft, balancing the needs for living quarters, production facilities, defense systems, and weaponry. Your decisions will shape the fate of your people as you explore the galaxy, seeking refuge from a relentless and overwhelming threat.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued support. The future of STARHOME is bright, and we are thrilled to have you with us on this journey through the stars.

[b]Welcome back to STARHOME![/b]
